title: Video Project
subject: listening

paragraphs.text: Section 3

TUTOR: First of all I'd just like to say, Cristina and Ibrahim, that I really enjoyed watching your video about student life last week, and I could see that the rest of the group did too. You did really well, and I hope that you got a lot out of it. I'd like to use this tutorial as a feedback session, where you reflect on the experience of doing the project. So Cristina, I was wondering, what did you enjoy most about making the video?
CRISTINA: I liked using the camera.
TUTOR: Is it the first time you've operated one like that?
CRISTINA: Yes, it is.
TUTOR: Well the results were very good! Anything else?
CRISTINA: I also enjoyed visiting one of the British students we filmed. I'd never been inside a British home before.
TUTOR: OK Cristina, thanks. What about you, Ibrahim? What did you enjoy?

IBRAHIM: Well for me it was a very good chance to get to know students who are on other courses, because everyone in our group is studying English, and we don't usually have much to do with the rest of the college.
TUTOR: Yes, good. Do you think you'll maintain the contact now?
IBRAHIM: I hope so. I've invited three of them to have dinner with me next week.
TUTOR: Great! If you haven't decided what to make yet I can tell you they'll love trying Arab dishes.
And of course, it's good for your English too. Cristina, what did you find? What was the most useful aspect of the project from the point of view of the English practice?

CRISTINA: I think, when we were being shown how to edit the film, we had to follow the instructions. And that was very good practice for me. And I also learned some technical words that I hadn't heard before.
TUTOR: What about you Ibrahim? What was the most useful for your English?

IBRAHIM: It was listening to the British students, because they don't speak as slowly as most of the tutors on our course. I think they speak at natural speed, so it forces me to get used to it. And they use a lot of slang.
TUTOR: So you learned some new words which will be useful?
IBRAHIM: Yes.

TUTOR: Good. I'm glad it helped. Well, we've talked a little bit about enjoyment, and about language practice. Were there any other benefits? What else did you feel you'd learnt from the project? Was it useful in other ways?

CRISTINA: Yes, well firstly, I learned how to use a video camera. And also, I think I really learned a lot about working together with other people. I've never done anything with a group before, and we had to find ways of cooperating, erm, and compromising, and sometimes persuading people, when they don't agree with you.
TUTOR: Yes, that is a very useful experience, I know.
TUTOR: What about you, Ibrahim?
IBRAHIM: Well, I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is.
When you're filming you think that everything's going to be interesting, but in fact we cut around half of it in the end, and then it was much better.

TUTOR: Good. Well, one last thing I'd like to ask. What mistakes do you think you, as a group that is, made? I mean, to put it another way, if you had to do it all over again, is there anything you'd do differently?

CRISTINA: We didn't plan very well. For example, we didn't decide on dates when we'd complete each separate step of the project, and we should have agreed about that in the beginning, because we were always late with everything!
TUTOR: Right. Anything else?
CRISTINA: I think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera. I mean with angles, and the focus and that kind of thing.
TUTOR: So you should have been more ambitious? Do you agree, Ibrahim?

IBRAHIM: Not really. In fact, I think we were too ambitious. We were inexperienced, and we didn't have a lot of time, and we tried to do too much, to make a long film. Next time I would make a shorter one and try to get the quality better.

TUTOR: Well, that's very interesting. Next semester we will be doing another video project - with a different content, of course - but you'll have an opportunity to put into practice what you've learnt this time. Do you have any ideas about...
TUTOR：首先我想说，克里斯蒂娜和易卜拉欣，我真的很喜欢看你们上周做的关于学生生活的视频，我可以看到，剩下的组员也很喜欢看。你们真的做得很好，我希望你们能从中得到很多。我想使用本节课作为一个反馈环节，你们来回顾由做该项目得到的经验。所以，克里斯蒂娜，我在想，你最喜欢制作这个视频的什么？
CRISTINA：我喜欢使用相机。
TUTOR：这是你第一次用吗？
CRISTINA：是的，是第一次。
TUTOR：效果很好!还有别的吗？
CRISTINA：我也很喜欢去见我们拍摄的一个英国学生。我之前从来没有去过英国家庭。
TUTOR：好的，谢谢。你呢，易卜拉欣？你喜欢什么？
IBRAHIM：对我来说这是一个去了解其他课程的学生很好的机会，因为我们班的每个人都在学习英语，而我们通常和大学其他人联系不太多。
TUTOR：是的，好的。你认为现在你会保持联系吗？
IBRAHIM：我希望如此。我已经邀请了三位和我下周一起吃晚餐。
TUTOR：很好! 如果你还没有决定吃什么，我可以告诉你，他们会喜欢尝试阿拉伯菜肴。当然，这对你的英语也有好处。克里斯蒂娜，你发现了什么？
CRISTINA：我认为，当我们显示如何编辑影片，我们不得不遵循指令。这对我来说是一种很好的练习。我也学会了我以前没听过的一些技术。
TUTOR：易卜拉欣，你呢？对你的英语最有帮助的是什么？
IBRAHIM：是听英国学生说话，因为他们不会像我们课程的大部分导师说得慢一点。我认为他们讲的是自然的速度，所以迫使我去适应它。他们也用大量的俚语。
TUTOR：所以你学了一些新单词，这会有用吗？
IBRAHIM：是的。
TUTOR：好，我很高兴它有帮助。好吧，我们谈了一点关于语言实践受益。还有其他好处吗？你还感觉你会从这个项目中学习到什么了吗？它在其他方面有用吗？
CRISTINA：是的，首先，我学会了如何使用摄像机。而且，我认为我真的学到了很多关于如何与其他人一起合作的事情。我之前未做过任何小组活动，我们必须找到办法合作，呃，妥协，有时是说服人们，当他们与你的观点不同的时候。
TUTOR：是的，这是一个非常有用的经验，我知道。
TUTOR：你呢，易卜拉欣？
IBRAHIM：嗯，我想我学到了很多关于编辑的重要性。当你拍摄的时候你认为每件事都会很有趣，但事实上我们在录制结束剪切掉一半内容，它会更好的。
TUTOR：好的，我想问的最后一件事。你认为你们团队合作的错误是什么？我的意思是，如果你不得不重新做一遍，有什么是你要改变的吗？
CRISTINA：我们没有计划的很好。例如，我们没有决定何时我们会完成项目的每一个单独的步骤，我们应该从一开始就达成一致，因为我们总是做什么都慢!
TUTOR：好的。还有别的吗？
CRISTINA：我认为我们应该多尝试不同的拍摄技巧。我的意思是角度和聚焦之类的。
TUTOR：你认为应该有更大的野心？你同意吗，易卜拉欣？
IBRAHIM：不是的。事实上，我觉得我们太有野心了。我们是没有经验的，我们没有太多的时间，我们试着做太多，做一个长的电影。下一次我尝试会做一个较短的电影，以获得更好的质量。
TUTOR：好，很有趣。下学期我们将做另一个不同内容的视频项目，当然，你们将有机会把你学到的东西付诸实践。你们有什么想法吗…

Section 3

TUTOR: First of all I'd just like to say, Cristina and Ibrahim, that I really enjoyed watching your video about student life last week, and I could see that the rest of the group did too. You did really well, and I hope that you got a lot out of it. I'd like to use this tutorial as a feedback session, where you reflect on the experience of doing the project. So Cristina, I was wondering, what did you enjoy most about making the video?
CRISTINA: I liked using the camera.
TUTOR: Is it the first time you've operated one like that?
CRISTINA: Yes, it is.
TUTOR: Well the results were very good! Anything else?
CRISTINA: I also enjoyed visiting one of the British students we filmed. I'd never been inside a British home before.
TUTOR: OK Cristina, thanks. What about you, Ibrahim? What did you enjoy?
IBRAHIM: Well for me it was a very good chance to get to know students who are on other courses, because everyone in our group is studying English, and we don't usually have much to do with the rest of the college.
TUTOR: Yes, good. Do you think you'll maintain the contact now?
IBRAHIM: I hope so. I've invited three of them to have dinner with me next week.
TUTOR: Great! If you haven't decided what to make yet I can tell you they'll love trying Arab dishes.
And of course, it's good for your English too. Cristina, what did you find? What was the most useful aspect of the project from the point of view of the English practice?
CRISTINA: I think, when we were being shown how to edit the film, we had to follow the instructions. And that was very good practice for me. And I also learned some technical words that I hadn't heard before.
TUTOR: What about you Ibrahim? What was the most useful for your English?
IBRAHIM: It was listening to the British students, because they don't speak as slowly as most of the tutors on our course. I think they speak at natural speed, so it forces me to get used to it. And they use a lot of slang.
TUTOR: So you learned some new words which will be useful?
IBRAHIM: Yes.
TUTOR: Good. I'm glad it helped. Well, we've talked a little bit about enjoyment, and about language practice. Were there any other benefits? What else did you feel you'd learnt from the project? Was it useful in other ways?
CRISTINA: Yes, well firstly, I learned how to use a video camera. And also, I think I really learned a lot about working together with other people. I've never done anything with a group before, and we had to find ways of cooperating, erm, and compromising, and sometimes persuading people, when they don't agree with you.
TUTOR: Yes, that is a very useful experience, I know.

TUTOR: What about you, Ibrahim?
IBRAHIM: Well, I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is.
When you're filming you think that everything's going to be interesting, but in fact we cut around half of it in the end, and then it was much better.
TUTOR: Good. Well, one last thing I'd like to ask. What mistakes do you think you, as a group that is, made? I mean, to put it another way, if you had to do it all over again, is there anything you'd do differently?
CRISTINA: We didn't plan very well. For example, we didn't decide on dates when we'd complete each separate step of the project, and we should have agreed about that in the beginning, because we were always late with everything!
TUTOR: Right. Anything else?
CRISTINA: I think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera. I mean with angles, and the focus and that kind of thing. 

TUTOR: So you should have been more ambitious? Do you agree, Ibrahim?
IBRAHIM: Not really. In fact, I think we were too ambitious. We were inexperienced, and we didn't have a lot of time, and we tried to do too much, to make a long film. Next time I would make a shorter one and try to get the quality better.
TUTOR: Well, that's very interesting. Next semester we will be doing another video project - with a different content, of course - but you'll have an opportunity to put into practice what you've learnt this time. Do you have any ideas about...

 

 

TUTOR：首先我想说，克里斯蒂娜和易卜拉欣，我真的很喜欢看你们上周做的关于学生生活的视频，我可以看到，剩下的组员也很喜欢看。你们真的做得很好，我希望你们能从中得到很多。我想使用本节课作为一个反馈环节，你们来回顾由做该项目得到的经验。所以，克里斯蒂娜，我在想，你最喜欢制作这个视频的什么？

CRISTINA：我喜欢使用相机。

TUTOR：这是你第一次用吗？

CRISTINA：是的，是第一次。

TUTOR：效果很好!还有别的吗？

CRISTINA：我也很喜欢去见我们拍摄的一个英国学生。我之前从来没有去过英国家庭。

TUTOR：好的，谢谢。你呢，易卜拉欣？你喜欢什么？

TUTOR：是的，好的。你认为现在你会保持联系吗？

IBRAHIM：我希望如此。我已经邀请了三位和我下周一起吃晚餐。

TUTOR：很好! 如果你还没有决定吃什么，我可以告诉你，他们会喜欢尝试阿拉伯菜肴。当然，这对你的英语也有好处。克里斯蒂娜，你发现了什么？

CRISTINA：我认为，当我们显示如何编辑影片，我们不得不遵循指令。这对我来说是一种很好的练习。我也学会了我以前没听过的一些技术。

TUTOR：易卜拉欣，你呢？对你的英语最有帮助的是什么？

IBRAHIM：是听英国学生说话，因为他们不会像我们课程的大部分导师说得慢一点。我认为他们讲的是自然的速度，所以迫使我去适应它。他们也用大量的俚语。

TUTOR：所以你学了一些新单词，这会有用吗？

IBRAHIM：是的。

TUTOR：好，我很高兴它有帮助。好吧，我们谈了一点关于语言实践受益。还有其他好处吗？你还感觉你会从这个项目中学习到什么了吗？它在其他方面有用吗？

CRISTINA：我们没有计划的很好。例如，我们没有决定何时我们会完成项目的每一个单独的步骤，我们应该从一开始就达成一致，因为我们总是做什么都慢!

TUTOR：好的。还有别的吗？
